findings.title: Prepared hearts find a sound course
findings.claim: Across the pericope, the heart-binding in 18:14 is presented as prepared guidance becoming usable direction: the inward center is steadied so that the youths can rise, reject an unsupported rival claim, and move within a sound course.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for heart-binding, the inner heart, and the verdict on shatat contact the surrounding occurrences of preparation, guidance, proof, and right direction. Those contacts change the focus from isolated courage into an action-ready and evidence-tested orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the binding as capacity for a practicable response, with guidance and proof shaping what the steadied hearts do.
findings.containment: The guidance, proof, and preparation images are contextual resonances, not literal replacement glosses for the focus words; the focus remains divine heart-binding and the explicit rejection of rival invocation. The external Fatiha overlay is not part of this finding.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supplies the nomination, while the packet supplies distinct focus and pericope occurrences and reciprocal connections for every retained branch.

findings.title: Undivided lordship reaches judgment
findings.claim: The focus's exclusive lordship includes protection and adjudication: no alternate deity means no co-ruler in the judgment that governs the order of the world and the community.
findings.mechanism: The focus names the Lord of the heavens and earth and rejects any deity besides Him. The closing context repeats the apart-from-Him formula and denies participation in His judgment, returning the focus exclusion through a concrete governing function.
findings.reader_payoff: Exclusive worship becomes newly perceptible as an undivided source of protection and judgment, not only a private devotional preference.
findings.containment: The finding extends the supplied lordship relation through the closing echo; it does not claim that the focus explicitly states every later governance detail or that the closing ayah is only a coda.

epistemic.reason: The repeated focus/context coordinates and lexical closure are exact, while the HFT source is legacy_unbound and two context branches remain unresolved.

findings.title: An affective counterfill
findings.claim: The scene may spatialize protection: steadiness fills the inner group while panic fills the uninvited observer at the cave boundary.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries fortified hearts and an inner affective center, while 18:18 explicitly says the observer would be filled with terror. The contrast permits a bounded reading of differently distributed affect without asserting transfer.
findings.reader_payoff: Protection becomes imaginable as a scene with an inwardly stabilized group and an outwardly destabilized gaze.
findings.containment: This remains exploratory. The packet never states that fear is transferred from the youths to the observer, so the finding says only that the two affective conditions form a protective contrast.

epistemic.reason: The focus and observer-terror anchors are exact, but the HFT record itself labels the inference exploratory and its source is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Living testimony and managed memory
findings.claim: The focus's living refusal of rival invocation may be placed beside 18:21's later taking, building, and prayer-site vocabulary as a tension between lived allegiance and communities' architectural management of memory.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries calling toward an object and explicitly denies another deity. The later context carries acquisition, building, and a prayer-site frame over the companions' remembered presence, returning the focus through the question of what later communities do with testimony.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a risk in which a living confession becomes an institutionally managed site without confusing that risk with a claim that the youths were worshipped.
findings.containment: This is exploratory and cross-domain. The later building does not say the youths were deified; the finding therefore states only a tension or risk in memory management, never evidence of a cult.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:21 anchors and contact roles are supplied, but the source is legacy_unbound and three context branches have no independent registry gloss.
